headline: 时光代理人领跑影视双榜
headlineEn: Link Click Leads Film and TV Charts
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周将迎3部新片；《时光代理人》同时领跑电影与剧集热度，《水晶湖》紧随其后，电影《害群之马》与剧集《幻视任务》亦受关注。
summaryEn: No new films open today, with three arriving this week. Link Click tops both film and TV heat, followed by Crystal Lake; film Black Sheep and series Vision Quest also draw attention.
